title: Avoid implying a mailbox send had no effect from an unclassified HTTP failure
outcome: Mailbox MCP typed diagnostics distinguish known unknown outcomes from answered errors without implying that an append could not have committed.
acceptance: An unmarked server failure and the post-home-receipt caller-replaced 409 are represented with neutral or unknown outcome semantics, rather than an asserted no-effect refusal.
Regression cases cover known unknown outcomes, answered 423 refusals, and errors after the home committed, without adding automatic retry or changing idempotency keys.
